question: In our technological world, the number of new inventions has been evolving daily. Please describe a new invention and determine whether it has a beneﬁcial or detrimental impact on society.
question_zh: 在我们的技术世界中，新发明的数量每天都在不断变化。请描述一项新发明并确定它对社会是否有有益或有害的影响。

question: Tobacco, mainly in the form of cigarettes, is one of the most widely-used drugs in the world. Over a billion adults legally smoke tobacco every day. The long term health costs are high- for smokers themselves, and for the wider community in terms of health care costs and lost productivity. Do governments have a legitimate role to legislate to protect citizens from the harmful eﬀects of their own decisions to smoke, or are such decisions up to the individual?
question_zh: 烟草，主要以香烟的形式存在，是世界上使用最广泛的毒品之一。每天有超过十亿成年人合法吸烟。对于吸烟者本身以及更广泛的社区来说，长期的健康成本很高，包括医疗保健费用和生产力损失。政府是否有合法的角色来立法来保护公民免受自己吸烟决定的有害影响，或者这种决定取决于个人？

question: In your opinion, what are the advantages and disadvantages of extreme or adventure sports?写作思路 advantages: As technology develops, extreme sports do not result in as many deaths as in the past, therefore, as long as the protection is suﬃcient There are varieties of physical and psychological beneﬁts such as developing courage, keeping healthy, building conﬁdence and releasing pressure. Extreme sports are very popular around the world. They are good tools for people around the world to communicate with each other. disadvantages: There are thousands of deaths and injuries due to extreme sports every year. Extreme sports utilize the natural environment. Since they are becoming more and more popular, many natural environments have been damaged.

Nowadays, more and more people engage in dangerous activities, such as skydiving and motorcycling. Are you in favor of them? Why? Since they are becoming more and more popular, many natural environments have been damaged. In favor of: Dangerous activities can promote economic growth and develop tourism. As technology develops, dangerous activities do not result in as many deaths as in the past, therefore, as long as the protection is suﬃcient There are varieties of physical and psychological beneﬁts such as developing courage, broadening horizons, keeping healthy, building conﬁdence, and releasing pressure. Dangerous activities are very popular around the world. They are good tools for people around the world to communicate with each other.

More and more countries spend large amounts of money on the restoration of buildings instead of on modern housing. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this analysis? Support your writing with your experience and/or examples. 写作思路 Agree, it is necessary to spend money on the restoration of old buildings. It preserves cultural heritage. It can create employment. Old buildings are important source of income as it can attract tourists.

Limit salaries of high earners would bring more equality No, it is bad, Talented people should be rewarded with high salaries A maximum wage may encourage employees to quit their jobs

Some people think air travel has more negative impact than positive on modern life. What do you think? 写作思路 Agree Air travel has adverse eﬀects on the environment as it releases a large amount of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. Noise pollution has a detrimental eﬀect on health.

Advanced technology such as artiﬁcial intelligence can translate a foreign language easily. Do you think learning a foreign language is still necessary? Support with your own experience. 写作思路 Agree learning a foreign language beneﬁts people’s career as it gives them a competitive advantage over monolingual candidates when they apply for jobs. Acquiring a second language can build up your self-conﬁdence.

What are the advantages and disadvantages of being over-competitive to individuals and society? 写作思路 Pros: motivate individuals to work harder and to achieve their potential Cons: increase mental stress

In the future, people will work less time at their jobs. To what extent do you agree with it? Please support your opinion with your own experience. 写作思路 Agree 1 better work and life balance working less time at jobs and allowing more time for family and leisure activities 2 improve health Less time at work would mean more time for physical activity

Should celebrities give up the right to privacy? 写作思路 Should not 1 Celebrities are humans. All humans need privacy and have a right to privacy under the law. 2 Giving up the right to privacy causes celebrities harm. The reason is that celebrities are often harassed or assaulted by stalkers or paparazzi.

Unemployment among young people is a serious problem. Some people suggest shorter working weeks instead of laying oﬀ employees. What do you think are the advantages and disadvantages? Is it also applicable to adults? 写作思路 advantages employees: improved work and life balance more time for family and leisure activities employers: avoid the cost of laying oﬀ and rehiring staﬀ disadvantages less time at work workers are unlikely to meet their work requirements Is it also applicable to adults? No, it is not Reducing hours would mean a lower salary. Many adults need money to pay for bills, housing and food. They also need to support their families.

Should schools have strict rules on wearing uniforms? 写作思路 Should: wearing school uniforms encourages discipline. remove peer pressure reduce distractions, students can focus on their learning should not: students have the right to make personal choice and to express themselves school uniforms can be a ﬁnancial burden for deprived families

More and more women are raising a family with a career. Please give your suggestions on a personal level and national level. 写作思路 Personal level: Raising a family with work is a growing trend. It is a common phenomenon to see many females enjoy their career and at the same time taking care of their families. What they receive is the doubleness of happiness and achievements, in work and in the family. However, work-life balance is also important to them in order to avoid the conﬂicts between two scenarios and also to avoid aﬀording too much pressure. National level: More women enter employment instead of being full-time housewives bring advantages to the labor force to the country. As such, in turn, the government needs to keep such energetic labor force sustainable. For example, governments can promote the signiﬁcance of women’s contribution regarding families and the economy in order to deepen the understanding of the whole society; governments can also encourage the choice of women who devote themselves to work and raising family at the same time, through legislation with reasonable rewards or tax cuts.

Some people believe that all cities and towns should have at least one large public open space. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Some people believe that all cities and towns should have at least one large public open space. To what extent do you agree or disagree? There is a debate regarding whether all cities and towns ought to have at least one large public open space or not. Personally, I am an advocate of this provocation, no matter in the context of large cities or small towns. There’s a necessity for large public open spaces to exist no matter in big cities or small towns. Human beings are born to have rights and free gatherings is one of the basic rights that humanity enjoys. As such, there supposed to be a public open space to support such situation. Considering the scale of gathering, a large public space can cater to the needs of people. For example, in the scenario of protesting, it is usually the outdoor public spaces enables people to conduct such behaviours. Furthermore, the public spaces also create opportunities to bring entertainments for citizens. It is often observed that people walk their pets, have a picnic and relax on the lawn in the public spaces, including parks, reserves and beach. The spaces provide a chance for people’s various entertaining activities. In turn, it would be catastrophic if all spaces are privately owned and people have to obtain permissions before entertainments. In a nutshell, based on the beneﬁts and necessity of public spaces as discussed previously, I strongly believe there should be at least one large public space for people to enter freely.

Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of diﬀerential education, i.e. splitting students into diﬀerent classes according to their academic performance. 写作思路 Advantages: Dividing students into diﬀerent classes bring advantages to both teachers and students. For teachers, it is easier for them to plan learning programs based on pupils' learning abilities. As children share similar learning capacities and academic performance, their needs appear similar to some extent. For students, studying with peers who have similar exam scores is more relaxed as they do not need to worry about others performing 'too well '. Disadvantages: Deciding classes simply depending on student 's academic performance denies school 's equity and students ' self-esteem. If top students are all put in the same classroom, whom can the so-called 'bottom ' students learn from? After all, every student has the rights to be treated equitably with equitable resources. Furthermore, being divided into a 'poor ' class will largely hurts a student 's self-esteem and kills their study motivation, which leads to school bullying.

Governments should focus on people 's lives or technologies used for space travel. To what extent do you agree with it? Use your examples. 写作思路 People’s life Ensuring people’s life quality is governments’ ﬁrst priority. In order to maintain the stability of a society, their contentment and happiness need to be taken into consideration. This refers to so-called ‘life quality’ . If people are starving or suﬀering from serious disastrous, such as drought and ﬂooding, what is the point for outer-space exploration? Thus, investing space exploration needs to give way to people’s life quality. As governments’ budgets mainly comes from taxation, whatever the choices governments make should support people’s true interests. So, we can imagine, for the majority of society, will they be interested in a medicine invention that can save millions of lives or in a space exploration that even may not be successful? Therefore, from the point of view of tax-payers, governments need to be responsible for people’s life ﬁrst and then think of investing space travel cautiously.

Some people argue that young people should concentrate on studying or work, and some people think it is better to put energy into activities designed to broaden their experience, such as international travel and volunteering. Support with examples or cases. 写作思路 Supports putting energy in activities designed to broaden their experience, such as international travel and volunteering. Participating in meaningful experiences provides opportunities for young people to deepen understanding of their study and work. Take volunteering work as an example, many young volunteers utilize their theoretical knowledge to help people, such as using physics knowledge to ﬁx electrical appliances. It is also known that many artists use traveling to seek inspirations in order to better work. Meaningful activities not only broaden people’s horizon, but also release their pressure. In the past-pace world, many people lost the balance between study or work and life. The ﬁrst thing they do in a day is to work and study, so is the last thing they undertake before sleeping, which eventually contributes to the high suicide rate worldwide. What they lack is the meaningful activities that show them the meaning of hard working and studying.

Poor lifestyles hurt people’s health. List some unhealthy lifestyles and discuss what government services could help. 写作思路 Unhealthy lifestyles: Poor diet leads to large overweight population. Lack of exercise Government Services: Place restriction on the quality control of the food that is served in the restaurants, especially fast-food restaurants. Use regular and aﬀordable health check from the government. Provide exercise facilities in the community and encourage people to workout.

There are numerous after-class activities for students. Is it good or not? 写作思路 Good: Students can learn more diverse skills and develop their interests. Students can meet diﬀerent people and enlarge their social circle as well improve their social skills. Parents can have more time to focus on their own works rather than taking care of children 24/7. Bad: Students will be distracted from their main study. Students will have more workload to complete and thus increase their stress level

Because university degrees can get jobs with higher salaries, university students should pay the full cost of their education. Do you agree or not? 写作思路 Disagree. Paying full fees of university education set barriers between the poor and higher education. Many countries introduce schemes to encourage people with desire and ability to enter universities. Take Australia as an example, it published diﬀerent policy in order to encourage as more domestic undergraduate and postgraduate students as possible to receive higher education. Requiring students to pay full fee will become the last straw on a camel 's back, which is the last thing government wants to see. University degrees indeed can contribute to students ' higher salaries, but it can never be the only reasons. A company needs to consider the combination quality of a talent, including his or her degree, previous experience and position, to decide the corresponding salary. This is to say that people 's salary is earned by themselves rather than only by their degrees, let alone the fact that many people are undertaking the job which does not match their degree. From this perspective, there is no reason for universities to ask students to pay full fee.

Parents play an important role in educating children as much as teachers. Do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 agree. Parents are children’s ﬁrst teachers. Since their births, children have started observing parents’ behaviors, listening to their languages and imitating some endeavors. In such way, children learn from parents both consciously and unconsciously all the time. It is not uncommon that children are observed in kindergartens or schools to perform their parent’s behaviors and languages for fun, which demonstrates how eﬀectively children learn from everyday scenarios by interacting with their parents. Apart from caring job, parents also do teacher’s work. This is probably why all teachers appreciate and advocate parent’s participation in children’s learning activities. Mothers and fathers help children reinforce what they learn at schools and assist them with their homework, through which children understand the knowledge they study at schools more deeply.

The purpose of education is for workers and good members of society, or individuals to fulﬁll their lives. Which opinion do you agree with? 写作思路 For workers and good members of society: education is the major driver of economic development, social cohesion, and cultural advancement. It is important to educate every member of the society to achieve these goals. For individuals to fulﬁll their life: education is the stair for individuals to achieve their life goal, obtain social status, and good personal income.

In the 18th century due to industrialization, a lot of people migrated to developed countries. This aﬀected lifestyle and increased problems in developed countries. What is your opinion about this? 写作思路 Agree Local people’s daily routine has been largely inﬂuenced negatively. With the invasion of immigrants, there is likely to appear more traﬃc during rushing hours. So, domestic residents have to leave their home much earlier in order to arrive at the workplace in time. They also tend to arrive home late if they cannot ﬁnish work early to avoid the rushing hour. Spending more time on traveling means less time to accompany family members, which might hurt the relationship in families to some extent. As new immigrants swam into cities, they are threatening local talent pool and job market, impacting on the social mobility. It is easy to imagine. For employers they have more choices before settling down to particular candidates. For potential interviewees, the game would be more competitive as more candidates join in, which without doubt contributes to the issue of unemployment. The higher unemployment rate is, the less stable a society becomes.

Discuss with your own experience. 写作思路 Living in foreign country advantage: experience diﬀerent kind of culture; have more job opportunity in developed country; extend social network; Disadvantage: cultural shock; language barrier; loneliness; discrimination

More people consider the ‘national happiness index’ as a better measurement of a country’s success than the country’s economic growth. What do you think about the idea? What can be used to measure ‘national happiness’? 写作思路 The ‘national happiness index’ is deﬁnitely a better measurement for a country’s success. The following can be used to measure: the life expectancy; family income; marital status; divorce rate; suicide rate

What do you think are the strengths and weaknesses of the education system in your country? Use your own experience to support your idea. 写作思路 Strength: comprehensive teaching techniques including group assignment, experiment, presentation, workshop practices and etc; assessments can reﬂect the true ability of the student. Weakness: education opportunity is not equal among all areas or communities; lack good teaching staﬀ in remote region.

University tuition fees are increasing. Some argue that higher education should be made free. To what extent do you agree? 写作思路 Agree: University should provide equal opportunity for all students regardless of their family income or social status; make university free of charge can also help those talented/excellent, but poor students to have the chance to get higher education. Disagree: University should not be free because they need to pay the high cost of academic research and salaries of the faculty.

Works of literature are a waste of time for students today. Do you agree and use your own experience? 写作思路 Agree: Not practical because we do not need it in our job and career. It is irrelevant thus it becomes boring and cannot engage students to learn. Disagree: It expands one’s horizons and provide diﬀerent angles to look at the world No learning is a waste of time. We should always oﬀer students a range of subjects to discover what they truly passion about

Media make people lose contact with real life, do you agree or disagree?写作思路 Disagree Media facilitates people’s engagement in real-life, which works like a bridge connecting the gap between humanity, especially in rural regions. They use video phone calls to meet friends and family members online anytime and anywhere as long as they have the reception, whereas in the past they could probably interact once a few months using mails. In such way, media stimulates people’s real-world communication. Even though some people might claim that human become addicted in the digital world, it is not the whole picture. Many people use media as a platform of interests that can be shared with others, which helps form, maintain and even stimulate relationships. You can imagine the scene that people watching movies together in the cinema, watching sports games together in front of the big screen in a bar, and even meeting friends they made through social media. These are all the example that how media has tighten us together.

The use of English seems to be growing as the world is interconnected, what reasons cause this phenomenon and what are the disadvantages and advantages of this? 写作思路 Study or work: concentrate on study or work will improve eﬃciency, save time and money. Join in activities: relax mind and body, help to improve eﬃciency from the other point of view; less stressed; learn practical skills; make more friends

Internet or media is bad for young people because they make the young generation poor in communication and forming relationships. Do you agree with this opinion? Please use examples or your personal experience to support your idea. 写作思路 Disagree Young people are the talents in this information era. Since they are born, they have been equipped with digital technologies and more capable to utilize Internet and digital media to cater to their own needs. For example, young people who are Youtubers make a fortune and inﬂuence on a large amount of people. These achievements are all based on eﬀective usage of social media and Internet, including eﬀective communication and establishing and maintaining healthy relationships. Old generation are often the one struggles in adapting to the environment with Internet and young generations are actually the one who saves them from their predicament. It is a common view that the older ages consult young colleagues when being introduced with some new software on computer or new application on cell-phones for communication. This scenario can be also found in the household context where my parents asks my advice about how to use some chatting apps to make friends. From this perspective, young people are actually the experts.

People should take part in sports either individually or in teams because people can learn many useful skills. How far do you agree? Explain and use examples or your own experience. 写作思路 Agree Individually speaking, people beneﬁt much from participating in sports practice. As sports, such as swimming and jogging, requires myriads of physical exercise, where we learn how to face physical challenges. For example, we would take deep breaths and other strategies to calm down when the respiratory rate is increasing during running, which is a handful skill that can be applied in other contexts, such as undertake labor work. From the perspective of teams, people are also armed with many useful skills, which is a bonus as essentially, we are all social animals rather. Many of the sports we join in are group ones, such as cricket and rugby, so people have to and will gradually be able to cooperate and communicate with others in order to perform well and make eﬀective contributions to the team. These are exactly the social skills we need to survive in the society, no mattering in schools or in the workplace. For example, I learn about taking on other people’s perspective in communication when playing footy and this skills makes me win the recognition from my colleagues as an educational leader.

There are more men or women in certain jobs and there’s nothing we can change about it. Do you agree with that? 写作思路 Disagree People are born to be equal so basically there is no diﬀerence between men and women in terms of their qualities. Men and women are actually able to undertake same kind of jobs as long as they wish to and there is no so-called ‘boundary ‘in any ﬁelds. For example, in peoples’ minds, teaching is a women’s thing but actually there is an increasing amount of men who take the work of teacher, from the early childhood to the universities. This pattern also works in construction as more and more women take the labor jobs. Thus, there no such a saying that men and women can only do certain jobs because the changes are already taking place. However, let’s step back to admit that in some industries, the ratio of genders is not balanced, but that does not mean we cannot do anything about it. For example, in the scenario of nursery or social work, there are indeed more women than men in some cases. But this current situation does not mean that it remains no changes permanently. The related-education is encouraging more men to undertake jobs in such ﬁelds and the fact is also positive. More man is entering this ﬁelds compared to the past and it would the matter of the time that the amount of men will be equal to women. So, what we do is in fact changing the unbalanced ratio.

Scientists believe that the increasing average temperature is an issue. What caused global warming and present solutions to reduce its eﬀect. 写作思路 What: Deforesting Carbon dioxide emissions from cars, and factories Over population Solution: Change to eco-friendly transport Use green energy like wind, water in a large scale

The experience of work is more important than qualifying. Do you agree or disagree?写作思路 Agree: The experience of work is more practical and eﬃcient. You don 't need to spend time on learning things that you will never needed in your job. Qualiﬁcation cannot prove your work capability, so it says more about whether you can do the job. Disagree: Only knowing the theory then you would have a comprehensive understanding of the work, which is vital for you to adapt to diﬀerent jobs. Qualiﬁcation means standard and proper training in detail, while work experience often do not cover everything.

Technology allows us to have a more useful and interesting life than in the past. Do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree Useful: Technology empowers humanity to explore the ﬁelds we never dream of previously. One of the examples of this can be the exploration of outer space. Recently Chinese Jade Rabbit 2 successfully landed on the back of the moon, creating the giant step of no time and sending extraordinary pictures of the moon’s back. Without new technologies people would not even know the galaxy, let alone to explore it. It also works in the medicine that without technology, the antibiotics would never be invented, which works as a life-saver that prolongs human’s life span. Thus, technology is useful in many areas. Interesting: Without technology, life is tedious and boring. Let’s trace back to the ancient times when technology stayed in the cradle. Without internet and other information technology, people could only physically chat with each other when staying face-to-face. They even needed to write letters to others if there was a long distance between them, which would take a few months to get a response. This time-consuming transmission largely reduces the fun in communication, let alone to make it interesting. So that is why communication in the past is mostly used in work for governors rather than as an entertainment for ordinary people. Thus, no technology means no fun.

Computer and online games should be banned from students in schools as they have no educational value. What’s your opinion? 写作思路 Disagree Computer and online games cannot be denied simply due to its educational value. Students, even children have rights and needs to play, according to the policy of United Nations published decades ago. These rights and needs are satisﬁed by entertainments and computer games are just one of them. So their existence and popularity demonstrates the reason why they have lived up for decades, which cannot be terminated simply from the educational perspective. Furthermore, online games actually have education value. It is not common that schools, especially primary schools in Australia, utilize computer games as one of the tools to teach and to facilitate children’s interests in learning. For example, there are many numeracy and literacy programs that incorporates computer games to fulﬁll such purpose and students love them. Based on such view, how can we wipe out all computer games simply because of some people’s bias?

The statement “Business and commercial organizations of any kind need to work hard to help with environmental challenges that are faced by the whole world.” To what extent do you agree with this? Talk about your view. 写作思路 Agree Commercial enterprises need to take responsibility to address the environmental issues as much of the environment degradations are caused by them. For example, many chemical factories produce unstandardized residue during their daily operation, which is discharged into local environments; and so does the greenhouse gases. By doing so, the domestic, even global environment is largely aﬀected in a negative way. Therefore, those companies need to clean their own mess. As one of the members in society, business and commercial groups need to do their duty to make positive contributions to the environmental challenges humanity faces currently. As environmental aggravation is currently occurring and being witnessed every day, individuals and governments are required to work jointly to address this issue. It is unfair for those companies and factories to stay out of it, especially considering the fact that their proﬁts are based on the sacriﬁce of environments.

As the urban population grows, city roads are busy and public areas such as parking are packed. People feel that city space is overcrowding. What solutions can you think of for this problem? 写作思路 From the perspective of the society, cities need to be expanded in order to cater to the growing needs derived from the growing population. As the population bomb theory was proposed decades ago, the rapid growth of population is no longer a new topic and governments are supposed to have a series of measures addressing such issue. One of them is ultimately utilizing current resources to expand the size of cities in order to embrace more people. For example, many car parks with multiple stories can be found in many cities in order to provide as many parking lots for people who use cars for work as possible. Thus, by properly using spatial space, there will be more space saved for people either to entertain, study or wok. Individually speaking, people should be encouraged to choose public transport instead of driving their own vehicles to release the pressure of traﬃc. The more population grows, the more cars would be witnessed running on the roads, which creates the overcrowding phenomenon. So, by encouraging people to choose public transport, such as trains and trams, the number of vehicles running on the streets will be largely reduced, which will help address the issue of overcrowding to some extent.

In globalization, it is impossible to succeed if you cannot speak at least one foreign language. Do you think everyone must learn at least one foreign language? 写作思路 Agree: 1.Foreign languages can be regarded as competitive advantage under the environment of globalization. Therefore, those who can speak more than one language can have more options for their careers. 2.Nowadays, employers prefer to recruit those who can speak more than one language, because multi-language employees are more likely to adapt to new culture or new environment. Not agree: 1.Although language can be a substantial advantage for a person, it is diﬃcult to say whether people can be successful or not by mastering more than one language. 2.There are many other factors, such as communication skills, interpersonal skills, can bring signiﬁcant inﬂuence to a person’s success. With the help of technology, people can still understand foreign languages even if they cannot speak at least one foreign language. Instead, people still cannot be successful if they do not master knowledge or skills in particular ﬁelds.

Is it realistic for everyone to expect job satisfaction?写作思路 Realistic: 1.Job satisfaction is an important factor for a person’s long-term career. This is because it can depend whether a person can obtain personal value or self-achievement from his job. 2.Without job satisfaction, people will believe that their work is not respected or approved by the companies. Therefore, people may lose conﬁdence and have no incentive to work hard. Not realistic: 1.As a way of making a living, people should focus more on salary rather than job satisfaction. This is because some jobs may require professional skills and can provide higher income. However, they also require long-time working and cannot guarantee people’s job satisfaction. 2.Most people change their jobs frequently, because they are not satisﬁed with the income, welfare, company culture or the physical environment. Therefore, people cannot achieve complete job satisfaction, as they have higher and higher standards for their jobs.

Lots of scientists agree that human activities increase global temperatures. Do you agree? Please give solutions for global warming. 写作思路 Agree: 1.More and more people can aﬀord to buy private cars. Therefore, more emissions are generated when people use their cars. Those emissions will ﬁnally become carbon dioxide and then increase the temperatures. 2.Companies use traditional energy such as coal or oil, which can produce harmful gasses that contain carbon dioxide. As a result, human activities indirectly increase global temperatures. Solutions: 1.From the perspective of human beings, people should reduce the use of private cars and try to use other alternatives, such as public transportation. 2.From the perspective of governments, more rules and legislations should be made to punish the companies that generate emissions beyond the reasonable level. 3.From the perspective of companies, it is their social responsibility to cooperate together to develop clean energy, so as to reduce the use of traditional energy.

Scientists have been debating the impact of nature and nurture on people’s personalities and behavior. Which one do you think has a greater inﬂuence on people’s personalities and behavior? 写作思路 Nature: 1.Nature can be regarded as physical environment ，the inﬂuence from parents or the place that a person grows up. It is reasonable that people’s personality and behaviors come from their parents, as parents are the ﬁrst teacher for their kids, and the inﬂuence is long-term. 2.Also, the physical environment can also inﬂuence a person. For example , people tend to be polite and are willing to obey the rules at a young age if most of their friends have such personalities or behaviors. Similarly, people’s bad habits also come from their friends, as they imitate their friends’ behaviors. Nurture: 1.Education can change people’ personalities and behaviors. Most teenagers, although they have bad habits or terrible performance in younger age, they can still change themselves if they receive good education. 2.Social environment is signiﬁcant. A person who behaves well at younger age does not mean that he can become a good person forever. A research shows that over 50% of crimes come from adults, and these adults have good performance at younger age. However, the complex social environment changes their behaviors and mislead them.

Some people think students should attend all classes they enrolled in, but other people believe that students can choose to attend the classes or not. Give your own opinion. 写作思路 Should attend all classes they enrolled in: 1.Most of the classes are compulsory, and the knowledge is connected. Therefore, enrolling in all the classes can help students to understand the knowledge comprehensively. 2.If the students want to pass the exams and obtain the qualiﬁcation, it is reasonable for them to attend all classes they enrolled in. This is because the classes can prove that students are capable of mastering the knowledge that are related to the degree Should choose to attend the classes or not : 1.Students should be given the opportunities to learn what they want. Some classes may contain the knowledge that they have already mastered. Therefore, it is waste of time if they still need to attend those classes. 2.Students will have more incentive to learn if they are given more options. However, if they are required to attend all classes, they may lose interest in study. Therefore, schools should encourage students to attend the classes they like.

The kind of a person’s life depends on his or her personality. What’s your opinion of this, and use your own experience as an example? 写作思路 Agree: 1.People‘s personalities are diﬀerent. Some people are ambitious, so they will set up their personal goals and try their best to achieve it. Therefore, they may be successful in their careers. However, some people may prefer to live a peaceful life, and they may not have too much incentive to achieve more in their careers. 2.Wealthy people are more willing to take risks, and therefore, they tend to live a life with higher quality. However, ordinary people are less likely to make changes, and therefore, the life of ordinary people is not as material as that of wealthy people. Not agree: 1.Education could be a major factor that can inﬂuence a person’s life. For some people, although they are ambitious and want to achieve success, they may not be able to live the life they want if they lacking of necessary education. 2.Social environment is very important. The kind of a person’s life can also be inﬂuenced by the company he works for, the friends around him, or the social opportunities he can obtain.

When you look for work, some people think salary is more important while others think the working conditions are more important. Which one is more important when you are looking for a job? 写作思路 Salary is more important: 1.Since people need to make a living by their jobs, it is reasonable that we need to take salary into consideration. 2.If the salary cannot maintain the quality of life for us, people may not have the incentive to work hard for their jobs, as they think that their performance cannot be respected and approved. Working condition is more important: 1.Working condition such as physical environment, working culture or working atmosphere, can bring a signiﬁcant inﬂuence to employees. If the working atmosphere is comfortable, people are more willing to work hard and start a long-term working relationship. 2.Sometimes, although the salary is not satisﬁable, people will still have the incentive to stay in a company if the working culture is consistent with his personal value.

It is equally important for school children and university students to be involved in extra- curricular activities as it is good for academic studies and examinations. What’s your opinion? Use your expertise or examples to support this. 写作思路 Agree: 1.Extra-curricular activities such as going hiking, visiting the museum, can open the horizons and expand the scope of knowledge for school children. 2.Universities should provide more extra-curricular activities such as volunteering, internships and so on. These activities can improve the employability and build up a sense of teamwork for students, which would be beneﬁcial for their future careers. Disagree: 1.For school children, they may get injured during the activities. Therefore, extra-curriculum activities may bring a threat to students’ safety, especially for young children. 2.For university students, they may lose the balance between activities and academic study. Those who perform well in extra-curriculum activities do not mean that they can perform well in examinations, and therefore, they may not pass the exam, and even cannot get the certiﬁcate.
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the public transportation system in your country?写作思路 Strength:

title_en: It is convenient, as the bus stations or subway stations are established near the city central.
title_zh: 公交车站或地铁站都建在市中心附近，很方便。

title_en: Most of the stations are established near the large shopping malls , schools or hospitals, which provide accessible transportation services for diﬀerent kinds of consumers.
title_zh: 车站大多建在大型商场、学校或医院附近，为不同类型的消费者提供便捷的交通服务。
question: Weakness:
question_zh: 弱点：

title_en: Most of the public transportation services are only provided in big cities or urban areas, and the whole public transportation system does not cover the small cities or rural areas.
title_zh: 大部分公共交通服务仅在大城市或市区提供，整个公共交通系统并未覆盖小城市或农村地区。

title_en: Crowded would be the main concern. During the rush hour, people want to catch the early bus or train, and some of them even fall down because of too crowded. Therefore, crowded cause a threat to public safety.
title_zh: 拥挤将是主要问题。在高峰时段，人们想赶早班车或火车，有些人甚至因为太拥挤而摔倒。因此，拥挤对公共安全造成威胁。

question: The primary purpose of any business, whether small or big, is not to change society or save the planet but to maximize the proﬁts. How far do you agree with this statement? Give the reasons and examples of your view. 写作思路 Agree: companies need to try their best to make money in order to survive in the current economy; therefore, it is necessary for them to maximize their proﬁts. Disagree: companies need to consider the future development, especially for the sustainability of future generation. Therefore, they also need to save energy, reduce wastes and participate in environmental protection.

Governments should allocate sources before the technology research, do you agree or disagree? Give your own experience and example. 写作思路 Agree: 1.The competition between countries is actually the competition of technology. Therefore, if governments can allocate sources prior to the technology research, the development of science and technology will have competitive advantage in the world. 2.Technology research is a big project, which requires longer time and a great deal of ﬁnancial funding. Therefore, governments should allocate sources such as human resources, equipment and ﬁnancial support to this ﬁeld. Only by doing this , can the long-term development of science and technology can be guaranteed Disagree: 1.It is diﬃcult to estimate how many sources should be allocated to technology research. Since other ﬁelds such as education, medical, also need related sources, governments should provide sources when it is needed. 2.The development of country should keep a balance between technology research and other ﬁelds. If governments only focus on science or technology, other public services such as compulsory education, social medical treatment , may not be guaranteed.

title_zh: 生活经验还是教育重要
question: Some people argue that experience is the best teacher. Life experiences can teach more eﬀectively than books or formal school education. How far do you agree with this idea? Support your opinion with reasons or your personal experience. 写作思路 Agree : 1.People will face many problems and diﬀerent situations in their life, and most of the solutions cannot be found from formal education. 2.With life experience, people can become mature as they grow up, and they can improve their abilities of handling diﬃcult problems. 3.Formal education only teaches people theoretical knowledge, but people need to apply those knowledge with their life experience. Disagree: 1.Formal education provides a basic framework of knowledge. Without knowledge, people cannot apply it to real situation ﬂexibly. 2.To obtain a higher degree or particular certiﬁcate, people still need to receive formal education to pass the exams. However, life experience is not always persuasive. 3.Most of jobs, such as doctors, lawyers or teachers, require a comprehensive understanding of theoretical knowledge, and this knowledge can only be obtained from schools.

What do you think of bidding to host sports events? Is it a blessing or a curse? Give your opinions. 写作思路 Blessing: 1.There is no doubt that bidding to host sports event can improve a country’s international position, so as to enhance its competitive advantage in the worldwide. 2.It can promote the economic development of the city. 3.It can increase the social awareness, enhancing the feeling of national pride. Curse: 1.More public facilities, buildings and gyms are built to reach the international standard, which require a lot of money. 2.Public are not able to make full use of those facilities or gyms, as they are obsolete after the sports events. 3.The host city will attract a lot of tourists, which creates a lot of problems, such as crowded and environmental burden.

Nowadays, people are more likely to type words. Do you think good handwriting is still important? Give your opinions. 写作思路 Handwriting is important: 1.If people rely too much on typing words, they will easily forget how to write. Moreover, some people may use the recorrect function with digital devices, which indirectly inﬂuence their abilities of handwriting. 2.Handwriting is a basic ability for everyone, and people need to master this ability since primary school. In addition, most of the exams still require handwriting. Handwriting is not important : 1.With the widely use of digital devices, people are able to ﬁnish written tasks eﬃciency, which saves a lot of time. 2.Digital devices have the function of recorrecting words automatically. If any mistakes are made, people can ﬁx the problem easily. This convenient method prevents people from making mistakes.

Lazy journalism has become commonplace in today’s digitalized world. Explain what is it and the cause of it. How do you deﬁne “lazy” journalism and what is the cause? 写作思路 Deﬁnition: ‘Lazy’ can be understood as journalists’ irresponsible behaviors. Lazy journalism happens when journalists do not fulﬁll their duty: not verifying the accuracy of the information they ﬁnd. It is common to see that some digital media share the same story, witness and comments. To make things worse, that story turns out to be false by authorities. This is how rumors have been spread out quickly and widely. Thus, when journalists do not do their homework and assume responsibility of their work, lazy journalism appears. Cause: One of the reasons causing the birth of lazy journalism is globalization. As globalization connects the world together, with news happening at any time anywhere, resources pool becomes inﬁnitely larger for journalists to choose from. It is truly challenging for journalists to verify the truth of a piece of news within limited time, especially when the news is happening abroad and evidence is diﬃcult to collect.

Governments promise continuous economic growth, but it’s actually an illusion. Some people think that governments should abandon this. Please talk about the validity and the implications. 写作思路 Validity: The promise of continuous economic growth may indeed be diﬃcult to fulﬁll, but economic growth is truly happening all the time. As the globalization makes the world an integrated economic system, one country’s economy can hardly be controlled only by its own government, let alone the continuous economic growth. However, this cannot deny the economic progress governments achieve. Take ourselves as an example, we are become more ﬁnancially capable to aﬀord the expense we never dream of, such as traveling abroad and buying properties as investments. The quality of our life is improving at a high speed, which is a potent proof of our growing economy because economy is the foundation to scaﬀold all these changes. Implication: The economic growth of any particular country is closely connected with every single household’s ﬁnancial condition, which can never be given up or neglected under any circumstance. For the society, the growth in economy brings myriads of employment opportunities, which saves myriads of unemployed people from desperation. In such way, society becomes more stable as people live and work in peace and contentment. Furthermore, individually speaking, both employees and business owners beneﬁt from positive economic growth, which guarantees better life for their families. Thus, ensuring a country’s economic growth, especially a continuous growth, is crucial for both individuals and society as a whole.

The only way to reduce air pollution is to increase the prices of fuels for vehicles. What is your opinion explain with your own experiences and examples. 写作思路 Not supportive: Increasing the prices of fuels for transportation is never the only way to reduce air pollution. Although the increase in fuel prices will lead to the decrease in vehicle-driving and eventually to the reduce in the emission, there are many other situations where smoke is created. Chemical factories emit unqualiﬁed smoke into the atmosphere during their production and the common way people deal with rubbish is burning, both of which contribute much to the air pollution. Supportive: Lifting up the prices of fuels can eﬀectively decrease the number of vehicles running on the roads every day, which is the only available way to reduce the air pollution. Although other facilities, such as factories and waste treatment plants, also produce smoke into the air, they cannot be limited due to their strong connection to our daily life. However, about vehicles, we always have the alternative.

The life that a person has depends on the personality, to what extent do you agree? From your own experience and examples. 写作思路 Supportive: From the perspective of human’s nature, people’s characteristics decide the way they live a life. When purchasing a product, people who pursue the high quality will drive miles away to choose the perfect one, while people who do not care much about quality may simply go to the nearby store to do shopping. To put most succinctly, diﬀerent characteristics decide people’s diﬀerent focus or preference when perceive the same information, which leads to the very diﬀerent outcomes. Not supportive: Many aspects together contributing to people’s life and personality is one of them. If people are simply driven by personality, there will be no diﬀerence between human and animals. In many occasions, people’s life depends on a combination of many elements, such as personality, sense and economic conditions.

Some people see prisons as the place where criminals should be punished, while some people think their primary function should be to teach them how to lead better lives. What is your opinion about the main function of time spent in prison punishment or rehabilitation? 写作思路 Support rehabilitation: From the perspective of humanity, prisoners deserve an opportunity to back on track of healthy lives. The prison separates them from the outside world and they undertake heavy labor work every day to make contributions to the society, which means they’ve already paid their debt. By equipping prisoners with proper education and practical skills, they can truly distinguish the good from the bad and be able to make a betting living after being released. Support punishment: From the perspective of social justice, people who commit crimes need to pay their debts, which is to receive punishments in the prison. If the prisons simply become the place for rehabilitation and criminals simply live in comfortable rooms and receive proper education, it will become a sarcasm to our social justice system. To make things worse, there even will be people deliberately break laws to enjoy the comfortable lives in the prison.

Younger employees have more skills, and knowledge and are more motivated than older employees. To what extent do you agree or disagree, support your argument with your own experience. 写作思路 Ideas: depend on industry. Young employees: Junior staﬀ usually have more knowledge in technology, especially in artiﬁcial intelligence industry. To be more speciﬁc, if this industry depend highly on technical skills, they may employ larger amount of competent workers under this prerequisite . They also demonstrated incredible physical strength and agility enabling them to dominate some labor-intensive industry. From my own experience, logistics serves as an typical example. Senior employees: Senior staﬀ are well-experienced, If they have been in the industry for years, they gained a substantial amount of institutional knowledge. More precisely, they can put that knowledge up front when selling themselves for positions. Furthermore, When it 's time to ﬁll a new or existing position, older workers are a great resource. In other words, they often are part of an extensive network of people who may be qualiﬁed for the open position, especially in network-based position like marketing manager. Moreover, this strong network that brought about by them will solve a lot of problems. Communication between companies and policy makers is a convincing example.

Some parents think children should do more extra classes, but others believe children should play after school. Discussed both views. Give your own opinion and experience. 写作思路 Should play: 1.From the perspective of children’s nature, children they are born to play. It is unfair to require children to undertake extra learning activities in their leisure time, killing their nature, under the circumstance that parents themselves enjoyed fun and playing with our friends when we were young. 2.However, when speaking of academic scores, it makes sense that parents want their children to do more extra-curriculum study in order to achieve higher academic performance. Yet having more extra classes does not necessarily mean higher scores in school. On the contrary, it can easily become children’s burden and let them lose interests in study.

Globalization has brought people closer together, especially in culture, communication, and business ﬁelds. Who do you think would beneﬁt the most from globalization? 写作思路 1.From the perspective of personal ﬁnance, business people enjoy tremendous beneﬁts from globalization. As globalization connects the world together, the market grows larger than before, which provides myriads of opportunities for business people to seek more potential consumers in order to maximize their proﬁts. 2.Personally speaking, job-hunters will beneﬁt the most from globalization. They no longer need to be limited in the local talents pool because globalization has already connected the world together. In other words, job-hunters are able to apply jobs in other countries or even on the other side of the globe as long as they are satisﬁed with the job conditions.

Some students choose a university near where they live and continue to stay at home with families, while other students choose a university away from family, what are the advantages and disadvantages for both sides? 写作思路 Advantages for near where they live

title_en: it is convenient for students to go back home easily, as they can enjoy the atmosphere of family gathering.
title_zh: 方便学生轻松回家，享受家庭聚会的氛围。

title_en: When students feel uncomfortable or have some illnesses, they can get access to familiar resources, for example, they can turn to doctors that they know for help, instead of ﬁnding medical resources in an unfamiliar city.
title_zh: 当学生感到不舒服或患有某些疾病时，他们可以利用熟悉的资源，例如，他们可以向自己认识的医生寻求帮助，而不是在陌生的城市寻找医疗资源。
question: Disadvantages for near where they live
question_zh: 离住处近的缺点

title_en: students will rely too much their families, lacking the abilities of being independent.
title_zh: 学生过于依赖家庭，缺乏独立的能力。

title_en: Students may lose the opportunities to explore the new places or expand their social circles, which may restrict their future development.
title_zh: 学生可能会失去探索新地方或扩大社交圈的机会，这可能会限制他们未来的发展。
question: Advantages for away from family
question_zh: 远离家人的好处

title_en: with the opportunities to go further, students are able to meet diﬀerent kinds of people
title_zh: 通过进一步发展的机会，学生能够结识不同类型的人
question: from diﬀerent places. This useful social network will absolutely provide a solid foundation for their future careers.
question_zh: 来自不同的地方。这个有用的社交网络绝对将为他们未来的职业生涯提供坚实的基础。

title_en: Students are given opportunities to learn more and experience more. For example,
title_zh: 学生有机会学习更多、体验更多。例如，
question: students who choose to study abroad can expand their scope of their knowledge and are given more choice for their future decisions. Disadvantages for away from family
question_zh: 选择出国留学的学生可以扩大自己的知识面，为自己未来的决定提供更多的选择。远离家人的坏处

title_en: students may suﬀer from homesickness in an unfamiliar place. If they cannot adjust their attitudes in correct ways, it may cause long term mental problems.
title_zh: 学生到了陌生的地方，难免会产生思乡之情。如果不能正确调整自己的态度，可能会导致长期的心理问题。

title_en: Studying in a place that is far away from home will be a big challenge for students. They
title_zh: 去远离家乡的地方学习对于学生来说是一个很大的挑战。他们
question: have to do all the things by themselves, such as cooking, ﬁnding doctors when they feel sick or even face discrimination from people with diﬀerent cultural background.
question_zh: 所有的事情都必须自己做，比如做饭、生病时找医生，甚至面临来自不同文化背景的人的歧视。

question: School children are doing less sport and exercise than their parents when they were young. How far do you agree with this statement? Give some examples from your personal experience. 写作思路 Agree: 1.Nowadays, with the common use of computers and smartphones, more and more school children are addicted to computer games. Therefore, they spend less time on sports and exercises. 2.In order to face with the ﬁerce competition in the job market, school children are required to ﬁnish lots of homework so as to be more competitive in the future. Since school children are under too much pressure from their study, they have no time to do sports or exercise. 3.In the past, the older generation does not have too much ways for entertainment, therefore, doing sports or exercise is a way for them to relax. However, the development of movies、 online shopping and tourism have enriched people’s lives, therefore, it is reasonable that school children are doing less sports and exercise than their parent generations. Disagree: 1.nowadays ， more and more people realize the importance of being healthy. Therefore, many schools conduct the activities such as climbing、camping or going hiking for school children. 2.Instead of doing traditional exercise like our older generations, more and more school children are interested in rock climbing or diving, which is also a new way for exercise. 3.In order to attract children’s attention, more clubs or school communities are established. For example, there are volley ball teams、dancing teams or swimming teams in the school. Some students even represent their schools to take part in the competition of the cities. Evidence has shown that there is an increasing demand for these clubs and communities.

Should wealthy countries provide some funding for poor countries? 写作思路 Wealthy countries should provide some funding to poor countries: 1.From the perspective of globalization, the connections between countries are closer than before. Providing funds to poor countries can promote the development of diﬀerent regions of the word, so as to achieve global sustainable development. 2.From the perspective of cooperation, poor countries can achieve economic growth if they are given more funds. In the meantime, poor countries can provide cheaper labor force to wealthy countries as a replacement. Therefore, both of these countries can achieve win-win situation. Wealthy countries should not provide funds to poor countries: 1.It is not realistic to provide funds to poor countries. This is because poverty is a long-term condition. Providing funds can only relieve the short-term situation instead of solving the problem. 2.It is unfair for wealthy countries to provide economic support for poor countries. Due to the nature of international competition, it is impossible to provide funds without getting any beneﬁts as a reward. Instead, the poor countries may totally rely on wealthy countries, which brings heavy pressure to the wealthy countries and therefore increase the gap between the poor and the rich.

Being a journalist is one of the most diﬃcult jobs in the world. To what extent, do you agree with it? 写作思路 Agree: To be a journalist, people need to master a lot of skills or knowledge, such as interpersonal skill, social skill or basic knowledge about particular ﬁelds, which are not easy for an ordinary person to do so. It is dangerous to be a journalist, especially for those who need to go to war zones to ﬁnd the materials to report. A lot of journalists died in the war zones without being known by the public Journalists need to be very sensitive to news and information. They always need to stand by for 24 hours in order to get the ﬁrst-hand materials Disagree: With the help of technology, journalists are able to get news and information easily, which reduce the possibility for going out to ﬁnd the materials. Working as soldiers will be more diﬃcult, as they have to ﬁght for their countries, while journalists just need to provide their reports. Skills such as social skill and interpersonal skill are also needed for other kinds of job, which are basic skills for being a journalist. However, other jobs such as engineers or doctors, which require more professional skills, would be more diﬃcult than working as journalists.

A good listener is better than a good talker in a social situation. Do you agree or disagree?写作思路 It is evidently reasonable for me to believe that listening is of greater signiﬁcance than talking, because people can not communicate properly without listening in order to give feedback information. More precisely, imagining a world where everyone keep talking but nobody listening, the information will not exchange, which means that the conversation is not successful, especially in social occasion. For example, if you and your friends both talking at the same time on phone, no body will listen so that the interaction will not be comfortable. As a result, the quality of communication will be improved because good listeners receive more information before they speak, and response more eﬀectively. In contrast, it is common to believe as a fact that communication skills should include talking, because they need to express themselves. Nevertheless, this argument may not hold water. It should be pointed out that talking is only the a part of the conversation. To be more speciﬁc, a good listener shows better understanding and respect in social situation. Moreover, listening can prevent interruption or formulate a response even before other speakers have ﬁnished. Therefore, good listeners are often some of the best speakers who can improve the quality of the communication.

Rather than choose a subject that is suitable for future employment possibilities, you should choose a subject that you are interested in or could get good grades. Agree or disagree? 写作思路 It is evidently reasonable for me to believe that students should choose the major for their career path due to the fact that the top issue after graduation is career building. This is because young graduates need a job to keep ﬁnancial independent, and employers prefer to recruit skilled candidates who study in speciﬁc subjects , which means that contenders with employment skills geared to the need of the position. More precisely, those employment preparation are provide in chosen majors. As a result, major choice will be career-deﬁning.

Do you think that young people should be restricted on certain things that they can do such as driving or smoking until they reach the age of 25? What are your views on this? 写作思路 It is evidently reasonable for me to believe that age limit is necessary. Mentally, adolescences and children are easy to be mislead, because of immature judgments. More precisely, they could be vulnerable when they get access to misleading information. Parental guidance notice on TV serves as a typical example. Moreover, if they contact with addiction when they are too young, they will catch bad habits, especially for cigarettes. Physically, young people are not mature enough, those additives pose threat to their development. As a result, age restriction help people keep away from danger, which is beneﬁcial to well- being.
Overcrowding should be solved by city planners rather than the policies to control the population. What is your opinion about this statement? 写作思路 Disagree

title_en: Policies to control the population have a deterrent eﬀect.
title_zh: 控制人口的政策具有威慑作用。
question: If people who violate the policy, they will receive punishments including ﬁne or even prison sentences. For example, one-child policy
question_zh: 如果违反该政策，他们将受到包括罚款甚至监禁在内的处罚。例如，独生子女政策

title_en: Policies to control the population is an eﬀective solution to the problem of overcrowding.
title_zh: 控制人口的政策是解决人口过度拥挤问题的有效办法。
question: policies are implemented by the government, which can eﬀectively raise the public awareness. The public would be encouraged to adhere to the policy.
question_zh: 政策由政府实施，可以有效提高公众意识。鼓励公众遵守该政策。

question: Should individuals limit the use of cars and use alternatives instead to protect the environment? 写作思路 Agree: motor vehicle cause air pollution and climate change due to the consumption of limited fossil fuels, which are ﬁnally detrimental to the environment. Citizens use alternative traﬃc like bus, bike and train in order to reduce the carbon footprint. To be more speciﬁc, the number of motor vehicles can be reduced. Moreover, with the development of technology, the green energy cars are burgeoning so that there are more options to travel in environmental friendly way. Hybrid cars serve as a typical example. As a result, limit the use of cars and alternative transport reduce the risk of environmental deterioration.

Is science more important than art to the society? 写作思路 Yes, science is more important: Practical and usable in daily life. Science can help human beings to develop our technology and improves life quality. Science can provide objective and measurable sultions to the problems, such as climate change, global warming. It keeps things in order and logical relations. No, art is more important: It’s what sets us apart from animals which do not express themselves in creative ways. Art encourages out of the box thinking and creative experiments which is a mindset that has helped us survive and thrive as a species. life is not only about eﬃciency and working. Art teach people to relax and enjoy their life.

Long-distance communication is helpful for both doctors and patients. Give your opinions about this statement. 写作思路 Pros: Without the necessity of being physically present, long distance allows the communication happen more regular and frequent. Doctors are able to collect the data for a longer period thus can identify the symptoms more precisely. It is more time and cost eﬃcient so that nobody needs to line up in the hospital. Cons: It is hard to judge the actual conditions of the patient through only long distance communication. The risk is awfully high if a patient’s disease is inaccurately identiﬁed. No equipment can be used to exam patients’ illness so many problems are challenging to be discovered.

Students obtain academic information from the Internet, teachers, printed books and articles, and discussions with peers. Which is the most reliable source? 写作思路 Internet Pros: The internet is grants each and everyone of us access to the combined knowledge and experience of all the people on this planet. Learn how to search the internet and you will have inﬁnite amount of knowledge to your exposal. Cons: A big issue whether the information found is accurate and trustworthy. There are numerous organisations which aim to inﬂuence mass media and social networks with fake news and propaganda. The internet is only reliable if you are discerning about which source to trust and question where they get their information from. Printed books Pros: Though also used for inﬂuencing the minds, is less corruptible and exploitable than the internet. Unlike website, books are clearly linked to authors and publishers who link their reputation and name to the book. One can expect books to more truthful and better researched than clickbait websites for example. Cons: It might contain inaccurate information. New change can not be easily updated into the printed books. It does not contain any critiques as it is often 1 way monologues.

Some people say it is time to say goodbye to real books with real paper because e-readers and e-books are available. Do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Pros: Environment friendly. Only producing digital materials would avoid deforestation, which can largely improve our environment. Authors can reach larger audiencies. Smaller authors can now reach large audiances, which was usually only for those with access to well-organised distributors. Digital books can be read aloud for visually impaired people. Digital books can be made tactile for blind people. You can quick search for words. Cons: Less money goes to authors. It commodities books. Easier for authors to copy from other authors. We lose the nostalgia and smell of paper books. We spend more time on screens. We use more power.

Some universities now oﬀer degree courses related to popular culture such as pop music and video gaming. Some people think these subjects are valid. What is your opinion? Give some examples. 写作思路 Pros: Pop music and video gaming are more related to our daily life so that we can ﬁnd signiﬁcant information pertaining to the particular cultural group. Gaming has been shown to enhance one’s ability for acute, tactical problem solving. Pop music is what binds us, something that transcends gender, race and age. We need more of this in society. Cons: We should not encourage people to spend time gaming and music, we need more engineers, teachers and nurses for example. Pop culture is a toxic trend in our society. It brainwashing minds to listen to unoriginal simplistic music. It teaches us to idolise idiotic individuals. It propagates hedonistic, sexual and criminal slurs onto young minds instead of teaching them about values and decency and honest hard work.

Some people think advertising is bad because it encourages people to buy things they do not need or cannot aﬀord, while others believe that advertising is good because it can improve people’s lives. What 's your opinion? Explain the answer with examples. 写作思路 Pro: Advertising encourages people’s creativity. It opens up imagination. It represents higher living standard and motivate people to make an eﬀort to strive what they desire. Advertising are the reasons why we can enjoy free entertainments like movie and TV shows and by itself, it is an interesting media form. Cons: Advertising promotes materialistic beliefs and persuades them to buy things they do not need. We will be forced by our endless desire. They endorse distorted views such as ‘thin is beauty’ and lead to discontent for many people. Advertising provide exaggerated image of product and inaccurate information.

People in rural areas are moving to urban areas for job and study opportunities. Do you think this development is positive? 写作思路 Positive: Urban areas can attract more talents. A stronger workforce can be created. This will promote the development of urban areas. Government will have to put more investment into infrastructures of urban areas, which provides better living conditions for people in urban ares. Negative: This will increase unemployment rate in urban areas. There are too many employers available in the labour market but limiter employees. And people from rural areas will dilute the opportunities available for local workers. This may cause serious problems for urban areas such as over-crowding and poor sanitation, aﬀecting the living conditions of majority of the population. This increases the burden on government and society. There will not be suﬃcient infrastructures supporting so many people in urban areas. A more competitive environment may be created in urban areas which may cause problems in the future.

title_zh: 健康饮食还是保持锻炼？
question: “A healthy diet is more important to keep ﬁt than exercise. ” Discuss, and use your example to prove your view. 写作思路 Agree: Many people do not have enough time and energy for exercise but they can still have healthy bodies since their diet is healthy. Diets can provide most of the nutrition that human body requires, so having healthy diet is suﬃcient to keep a healthy body. Disagree: There are certain diseases which are directly related to lack of exercise, such as osteoporosis (骨质疏松) and muscular atrophy (肌肉萎缩). These cannot be improved by healthy diets. If we never take exercise, we cannot have a healthy body even if our diet is healthy.

With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete. Universities should only procure digital materials rather than constantly updating textbooks. Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this position and give your point of view. 写作思路 Advantages: Digital materials can be accessible to students without the limits of time and locations, which is more convenient for students. Digital materials are more environmentally friendly than traditional textbooks. Digital materials can be preserved for a longer period while paper can be easily degraded. Disadvantages: Digital materials can be easier to be lost due to the malfunction of digital devices while traditional textbooks will never disappear. Some students have the preference to read traditional paper textbooks, and if the universities only procure digital materials, these students’ motivations of study may be aﬀected.

Online content such as music, videos, consumer-generated content, or blogs is accessible to all users at no cost in technically advanced society today. To what extent do you agree people should pay for online content or not? 写作思路 Should pay: Online content is the eﬀort of other people, which should be respected and be paid. Paying for online content gives those authors motivations to produce more and better products for people to enjoy. Should not pay: The content on the internet should be equally available to everyone. If there is an extra cost, some people may not be able to enjoy it, which is not fair. No cost can attract more viewers, which is a better way to show the respect to the eﬀorts of the authors.

Creativity is something that a person is born with, other people think that creativity can be taught or developed. To what aspect do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Be born with: Most genius artists show their talents at a very young age before being trained. Sometimes teaching can suppress creativity since there are too many strict rules and disciplines. Can be taught: Creativity needs to be based on some kinds of knowledge and follows certain rules which need to be taught. For example, although producing paintings largely rely on creativity, basic rules still apply. Creativity can be aﬀected by many factors such as the way of thinking which needs to be developed in lives.

In some countries, the birth rate is slowing, the a problem of an aging population, what are the causes and eﬀects of this issue? How to solve this problem? 写作思路 Causes: Young women nowadays are not willing to give birth to and raise children since they would like to focus more on their careers and personal lives. Eﬀects: Decreasing birth rate results in ageing population, and ageing population increases the pressure of the society. There will be less available employees in the workforce and more services provided for elder people will be required. Solution: Governments need to introduce policies to encourage young generation to have babies. For example, more allowance can be provided for each baby born.

A healthy body is more reliant on a healthy diet than exercise. Do you agree? Share your personal experience to support the statement. 写作思路 Agree: Many people do not have enough time and energy for exercise but they can still have healthy bodies since their diet is healthy. Diets can provide most of the nutrition that human body requires, so having healthy diet is suﬃcient to keep a healthy body. Disagree: There are certain diseases which are directly related to lack of exercise, such as osteoporosis (骨质疏松) and muscular atrophy (肌肉萎缩). These cannot be improved by healthy diets. If we never take exercise, we cannot have a healthy body even if our diet is healthy.

Teenagers should receive lessons on principles of personal ﬁnance, such as investing and debt. To what extent do you agree with this statement? 写作思路 Agree: Personal ﬁnance is very important in the later stages of their lives, therefore, it is good to teach teenagers in advance so that they will be able to handle their money in better ways and live better lives in the future. It is good to teach teenagers such lessons which will be useful in their lives when they have enough time and energy to receive the information. When they leave schools, they may not have chances to take such lessons any more. Teaching teenagers such lessons can help them avoid being defrauded. Disagree: If teenagers receive information related to personal ﬁnance when they are too young, they may have not developed the ability to judge right or wrong. It is possible that they use the information in wrong ways and become greedy and tricky. For teenagers, the most important thing in school should be learning basic knowledge such as science, maths, etc. Other things such as personal ﬁnance will be learned naturally in the later stages of their lives.

Many workers like nurses and teachers should get more pay, especially in recent years when people in ﬁnance, ﬁlm actors, and company leaders are paid a larger amount of money. To what extent do you agree or disagree with the above statement and what’s your opinion? 写作思路 Agree: The jobs of nurses and teachers are related to public services which are very important and indispensable in our society. Workers like nurses and teachers tend to have longer working hours and they work very hard. They deserve to be paid more. Disagree: There are more people who have the ability to take the jobs of nurses and teachers and that is why their salary is not as high as actors or company leaders. People’s salary should be related to how much values they create. Actors and company leaders help the companies earn so much money that they deserve to be paid more, while nurses and teachers are not able to create such high values.

Education is important as it teaches ethics and life value as it teach us practical things for future employment. What is your opinion? 写作思路 Agree: Ethics and life values are very important no matter what you do in your life. Therefore, they are more important than practical things. Many people do not do what they learn from schools as their jobs, so those practical things are usually developed during the employment instead of in schools. Therefore in schools, it is more important to learn ethics and life values. Disagree: The basic aim of education is to help students get jobs in the future, therefore, it is important to learn practical things for future employment in schools. Ethics and life values should not be learned through education, but through life experience. Therefore, the most important thing learned through education is the practical things for future employment.

Increase in information in media, the role of a library in updating textbooks is obsolete, agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: Information in media can be accessible to people without the limits of time and locations. Accessing information in media is more environmentally friendly than traditional textbooks. The constructions of libraries take large costs which can be avoided by accessing information in media instead. Disagree: Fake information can be easily spread in media, therefore, the information obtained in media may not be true and correct. Many people have the preference to read traditional textbooks. They do not like browsing information in media.

The government should reduce its investment in arts, music, and painting. Agree or Disagree. 写作思路 Agree: There are many other important public sectors that need investments, such as infrastructures and health services. Arts, music and paintings can get enough investments from private sectors, therefore, the government can reduce the investments in them. Disagree: Arts, music and paintings can generate economic proﬁts for the society. For example, some exhibitions and music festivals can make a lot of earnings.
