Arts, music and paintings represent local cultures. Diﬀerent places have diﬀerent forms of arts, and local government has the responsibility to preserve these unique art forms.

Due to cities ' expansion, governments should create better public transport available to everyone rather than build more roads for the vehicle-owning population. To what extent do you agree with this statement? Give the reasons for your opinion. 写作思路 Agree: As technology develops rapidly, there are more and more vehicles on roads. Therefore, current road system is not enough to accommodate so many vehicles. Nowadays, more and more people purchase personal vehicles, resulting in less people using public transport. Therefore, government does not need to increase investment in public transport. Disagree: Improving the network of public transport can encourage people to use it instead of driving their cars. This is much more environmentally friendly. For citizens, public transport is much cheaper than purchasing cars. If the network of public transport is suﬃcient, a family does not need to purchase several cars, which is much more cost-eﬃcient.

The belching and unauthorized behavior is unacceptable in modern oﬃces. How far do you support this view? Give your response with justiﬁcation. 写作思路 Agree: These behaviors can aﬀect others in the oﬃces, both physically and emotionally. Trying to restrain these behaviors shows one’s good manner and professional quality. Disagree: These behaviors are physical reactions that cannot be stopped consciously. Therefore, we should understand each other in oﬃces. A circumstance is that some people feel unwell and cannot control themselves, and it should be understood.

When you 're at the end of your rope, tie a knot and hold on. How far do you agree with Theodore Roosevelt 's quote? 写作思路 Agree: When you reach the end of the rope, the situation will not get any worse. It means as long as you hold on and try to climb back, the results will be better than giving up. Sometime you think you have reached the end, but it may not be true. There may be alternative pathways for you to climb back. Therefore, we should never give up even though we see no hope. Once you get rid of the end of the rope, nothing ahead can scare you and beat you any more because you have experienced the worst situation.

Nowadays, bickering is a common trend amongst youngsters and married people. This has led to polygamy and high divorce rates. Justify the response with your positive or negative views. 写作思路 Positive: Bickering is way of communication. If two people are not suitable to be together, getting divorce is not a bad thing. If their dispute can be settled by bickering, it means they can still be together and keep their marriage. Therefore, bickering is an eﬀective way to test if two people should be together. Bickering is a way to share diﬀerent opinions. Not only people with the same opinions can be married. If they can understand and accept others’ opinions, they can get married still. Otherwise, if they get divorced, it means they are not suitable to each other. Negative: Bickering can sometimes lead to violence, which is a serious problem. Sometimes getting divorce is a result of impulsion. People regret after they really get divorced or cheat on each other.

The traditional subjects are soon moving oﬀ in last years? Kindly provide the solutions and ideas to save such subjects. 写作思路 Solutions: The way of teaching needs to be more attractive so that students ﬁnd it more interesting to take these subjects. For example, to study literature, students can participate in drama performances. To study maths, real life situations can be utilized. The contents of the lessons should be adjusted to be more practical, so that they can be used in real life situations. Basic theories can be taught but not too deeply. The more important content should be how to use these subjects in real life situations.

Put the examination at the end of the semester or separate small tests throughout the entire semester, which one is better? 写作思路 At the end of the semester: Students can review the materials for the whole semester at the end so that they can understand all of them. If small tests are put throughout the semester, students may not be able to recall the previous materials. It is easier for teachers and professors to assess their students. Their work loads are reduced. Throughout the semester: The materials on each small test are limited, so students have less pressure compared to taking a ﬁnal exam at the end. The small tests can push students to study constantly during the semester, and make sure students do not only study for the last few weeks. It is a fairer way to test the knowledge that students obtain throughout the semester. If only put one examination at the end, some students may not demonstrate their real abilities due to some external factors and they do not have another chance to prove themselves.

Which should require more ﬁnancial support from the government: health or education. To what extent do you agree or not? use your experience. 写作思路 Health: The problem of ageing population occurs in most societies. Therefore, more health support and services should be provided for elder people. The government should be responsible for extending citizens’ life expectancy and enhancing health conditions, therefore, more ﬁnancial support should be put into the health sector. Education: Good education system can train more capable people who can later contribute to the society, which is good for the development of the society. A good education system represents a better development of the society, therefore, the government should be focusing more on this sector.

Some people say music promotes children 's learning. However, there are mixed results on the impact of music generated by researchers. To what extent do you agree or disagree that: music has impacts on humans ' lives? 写作思路 Agree: Appropriate songs with lyrics help young children develop their lingual abilities, exposing them to new vocabulary and varieties of pronunciations. Appropriate dancing music enhances young children’s brain development regarding the motor skills and abilities. Appropriate music is a strong tool making learning more interesting for young children. Certain kinds of music can increase the motivations and eﬃciency of learning. Research has revealed that light music can make children concentrate on learning. Disagree: There are many songs with inappropriate lyrics and messages that should not be exposed to children.

Schools should organize activities after class. 写作思路 Agree: After school activities enrich students’ leisure time. They can do activities that they are interested in and they can make new friends. After school activities help students develop hobbies which they can insist for their whole life. Studying is not the most important thing. After school activities help students develop valuable skills and abilities such as time management and team work. Disagree: After school activities take up the time for students to study. Some students may spend too much time on after school activities and do not do enough to study. Students can choose their own interests after school, therefore, schools do not need to organize activities for them.

Medical technology is responsible for increasing average life expectancy. Is it a blessing or a curse? 写作思路 Blessing: People have more time to enjoy their life and do whatever they like to do. Longer life expectancy means people can work till an older age and delay their retirement, which is a good thing for the workforce. Cursing: Ageing population may be resulted, which increases the pressure of the society. For example, more infrastructures and health services for elder people are required. Although people’s life expectancy is extended, their health conditions may not be improved. Therefore, people may spend more money on health management when they reach old ages.

Studying eﬀectively requires comfort, peace, and time. So a student can 't combine learning and employment at the same time because one distracts the other. Is it realistic to combine them at the same time? Support your opinion with examples. 写作思路 Combine: Combing study and employment helps students develop practical skills required for future employment. Not being able to focus on one thing helps students develop the skill of time management, which is important for life. Not combine: Employment distracts students from their study, thus leading to bad results. Also students cannot spend their whole time and energy on working, which means they cannot get good results in employment either.

In a cashless society, people use more credit cards. The cashless society seems to be a reality, and how realistic do you think? What are the advantages and disadvantages of this phenomenon? 写作思路 Advantages: It is much more convenient. Especially when people purchase expensive things they do not need to take much cash with them. It is more secure. If cash is lost, it is hard to ﬁnd it. However, if a card is lost, one can quickly notify the bank and get a new one, and the money is still in that card. Using cards is more environmentally friendly, saving paper. Disadvantages: Card-related crimes are more easily to be performed. For example, some people steal the information of others’ cards and use the money in them. Also, some people may utilize credit cards to commit fraud. Credit cards sometimes put more pressure on people. Unlike cash, people could spend money in advance with credit cards, and some people spend so much money that they actually do not have the ability to pay it back. Using cash would not have such problems.

How does the design of a building aﬀect, either positively or negatively, where people work and live? 写作思路 Positive: The design of buildings nowadays provides much convenience for people. For example, most buildings have gyms and other facilities. The design of buildings nowadays provides nice and comfortable environment for people to live and work in. This can increase eﬃciency and build positive attitudes. Negative: Some aspects of the design of buildings nowadays result in pollution. For example, large glasses used for buildings may lead to light pollution. Some aspects of the design of buildings nowadays result in danger. For example, some buildings are designed very high where the geography may not be suitable. This is a potential danger in the future. Most design of buildings nowadays results in a crowded living condition. Since most buildings would like to accommodate more residents, there are too many apartments on one level.

The importance of cars and airplanes in modern life. Give examples. 写作思路 Cars and airplanes provide convenience for people. People in modern life tend to travel more across cities, countries and continents. Without cars and airplanes, these travels cannot occur. Cars and airplanes bring diﬀerent cultures closer. People from diﬀerent parts of the world can get together to communicate. Cooperations and tradings between countries can be realized more easily.

Whether studying ﬁlms at school is as important as studying literature? Do you think schools should have a curriculum asking students to play old drama and work for theater centuries ago? 写作思路 Studying ﬁlms is as important: Film is a very powerful way to tell stories and express feelings, which is very diﬀerent from literature. Therefore, studying ﬁlms is as important as studying literature. Film, compared to literature, is a relatively new form of art. Students should be exposed to new things instead of being taught traditional things over and over again. Should play drama: It is a more interesting way to study. Playing old drama can help them understand and remember the content better. Playing old drama helps student build a sense of team cooperation and spirit, and improve teamwork and communication skills.

Children should take a large number of exams or learn more in schools. 写作思路 Should: It is important to teach children foundations of knowledge when they are young so that they can receive more advanced knowledge in the future more quickly and easily. Therefore, children should learn more. It is easier for people to receive new knowledge at younger ages, therefore, children should learn as much as they can before they lose the chance. Should not: A happy childhood is the key leading to a happy life later. A large number of exams puts much pressure on children, which can make them unhappy. Every children has diﬀerent interests. Knowledge is not the most important thing to achieve success in life. Children should have freedom to choose their own interests to study instead of learning as much as possible.

The time people devote to jobs leaves very little time for their personal lives. How widespread is the problem? What problem will this shortage of time cause? 写作思路 How widespread: The problem is widespread over the world. Most people nowadays spend too much time on working and they have no time for their personal life. Problems: Every person lives only once. If all of the time is devoted in jobs, people have no time to enjoy the things they like or try new things, which is a waste of the only chance of living in this world. Devoting all the time in job causes a lot of health problems, both physically and emotionally. People need leisure time to enjoy life, relax their body and minds to keep healthy. Devoting all the time in job may result in intense relationships between family members and friends due to lack of communication.

Some people point out that experiential learning(i.e., learning by doing) can work well in formal education. However, others think a traditional form of teaching is the best. Do you think experiential learning is beneﬁcial in high school or college? 写作思路 Agree: Experience can teach students practical skills which are useful for both future employment and life. Learning through experience is more interesting, making the knowledge more understandable and impressive. Compared to books and formal education, students tend to learn more and remember more. Disagree: Experience should be based on knowledge, therefore, books and formal education are the foundations and are the best ways to teach. What you remember from the books can deﬁnitely be used in experience, but what you learn from experience may not be remembered if you do not experience the same thing over and over again.

Some universities deduct marks from students ' work if given late. What are your views and what action will you recommend taking? 写作思路 Views (should): Meeting deadline is a valuable characteristics, therefore, deducting marks from late given works can help students develop such concepts and always meet deadlines in their future employment. Views (shouldn’t): This gives too much pressure on students, especially under some understandable circumstances, which may have negative eﬀects on students’ mental health. Actions: Make clear and reasonable rules on under what circumstances late given works can be acceptable. These rules need to be agreed by students so that students do not feel too much pressure. To give early submitted works extra rewards to encourage students submit the works in time or even earlier.
Space travel is fantastic these days, but there are many issues, such as environmental problems that we should be focusing on. What are your views on the allocation of public funding?
question_zh: 如今，太空旅行非常棒，但也存在许多问题，例如我们应该关注的环境问题。您对公共资金的分配有何看法？

question: Some people think placing advertisements in schools is a great resource for public schools that need additional funding, but others think it exploits children by treating them as a captive audience for corporate sponsors. Choose which position you most agree with and discuss why you chose that position. Support your point of view with details from your own experiences, observations, or reading.
question_zh: 一些人认为，在学校投放广告对于需要额外资金的公立学校来说是一个很好的资源，但另一些人则认为，这通过将儿童视为企业赞助商的俘虏受众来剥削儿童。选择您最同意的立场并讨论您选择该立场的原因。用你自己的经历、观察或阅读中的细节来支持你的观点。

question: In a less developed country, do you think the disadvantages of tourism can be as great as the advantages? 写作思路 Advantages: Tourism can boom the economy of developing countries. Visitors can bring enormous earnings and GDP. Tourism helps developing countries communicate with other cultures, which is important for development. Disadvantages: Tourism can largely destroy natural environment and bring environmental problems. Tourism can disturb the normal life of local residents. Over-crowding problem may be resulted and usually there is an increase in prices of goods and services.

What are the pros and cons of staying connected on social media for 24 hours a day?写作思路 Pros: It is more convenient for people to communicate. Wherever they are, they can talk to whoever they want without limits. This bring convenience in both life and work. Social media brings people closer. For example, if a child does not live in the same country with his parents, he can still talk to them all the time. They do not feel they are far apart. Cons: Sometimes people rely too much on social media that they forget to talk to people around them in real life. They do not talk even if they sit together, and they rather talk to someone over the phone. Health problems may be resulted if looking at computers or phones all the time.

Successful sports stars and glamorous ﬁlm stars are role models for youngsters. Do you agree with this statement? 写作思路 Agree: These people shine on the TV since they are successful, and their success is the result of their hard working and varieties of valuable characteristics. Therefore, they are role models for youngsters so that youngsters can learn positive things from them. Youngsters may look at these stars’ good lives and want to live a life like this later. Therefore, they will work hard to achieve this goal. Disagree: Successful sports and ﬁlm stars sometimes do not aﬀect youngsters in a right way. Instead of learning from them, youngsters spend a lot of time and money to show their support, which makes very little sense. Not all of the successful stars are perfect. Some of them have bad habits or behaviors which are sometimes copied by youngsters.

Is imitating celebrities in sports and movies good or bad?写作思路 Good: These people shine on the TV since they are successful, and their success is the result of their hard working and professional attitudes. Therefore, imitating them is a way to learn from them. Bad: Not all of the successful stars are perfect. Some of them have bad habits or behaviors which should not be imitated. Everyone has his own personalities and features. Imitating others is a way to eliminate one’s own characteristics.

What are the positive and negative aspects of the connection to the outside world including mobile phones, email, and social networking? 写作思路 Positive: They are very fast ways of communication. They can text, send emails or messages at any time and can get replies in no time. There is no time wasted on waiting. It is more convenient for people to communicate. Wherever they are, they can talk to whoever they want without limits. This bring convenience in both personal life and work. These ways of communication bring people closer. For example, if a child does not live in the same country with his parents, he can still talk to them all the time. They do not feel they are far apart. Negative: Sometimes people rely too much on these connections that they forget to talk to people around them in real life. They do not talk even if they sit together, and they rather talk to someone over the phone. Health problems may be resulted if looking at computers or phones all the time.

What is your view on the idea that it takes failure to achieve success?写作思路 Agree: Taking trials is a very must thing to do before achieving success, therefore, there must be failures before success. Only failures can help people understand what is wrong and how to achieve success. No one can take every right step for the ﬁrst time. Failures are the only opportunities to learn. People can never make progress with success.

What does generosity mean to you?写作思路 Satisfaction can never be gained if we only think about ourselves and are not willing to give. If we keep giving, we will never feel poor. We can get psychological satisfaction when we give. Tolerance can be an aspect of generosity. We should tolerant diﬀerent cultures, diﬀerent life habits and diﬀerent appearances. We should be able to accept whatever is diﬀerent from ourselves.

Most high-level jobs are done by men. Should governments encourage that a certain percentage of these jobs be reserved for women? What is your opinion? 写作思路 Agree: It is a time of gender equality. Not only men are capable to do high-level jobs. Some women are capable as well and they are just stopped by the traditional concepts. Therefore, they need some encouragement from governments. It is important to balance the sex ratio in any work ﬁeld. Men and women have diﬀerent ways of thinking and reacting, thus they can propose diﬀerent ideas. This is a way to increase eﬃciency. Disagree: Men and women are diﬀerent in genes. Their brains develop to perform diﬀerent functions. Therefore, it is natural that men are good at some kinds of jobs while women are good at others. Governments should not step in this result of natural selection. The situation now is developed naturally over years and achieves a balance. The disturbance of governments can only lead to decreasing eﬃciency. Changes can be made naturally if required.

Xenophobia has accelerated rapidly in Western countries. According to you what solutions can be proposed by the government and individuals? 写作思路 Solutions: Government can encourage migration, attracting more people from diﬀerent cultures to come to the country and letting diﬀerent cultures communicate. Government can focus more on tourism industry so that people from diﬀerent cultures can come to the country. For individuals, they can travel more to other countries and cultures to experience diﬀerent things, widening their sights and horizons.

Sports and games create disturbance in students ' life because students cannot fully concentrate on their studies. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Disagree: Studying is not the most important thing during school life. Sports and games help students develop their own interests and hobbies which they can insist for the rest of their lives. Sports and games can actually help students develop varieties of useful skills, such as teamwork skills, time management, sense of cooperation and responsibility. All of these are very important for their lives. Sports and games keep students healthy. If they study all the time, health problems will deﬁnitely be resulted. Exercises are very important for students to keep healthy bodies. Agree: Sports and games tend to take up a lot of time, which means students do not have enough time for studying. This will deﬁnitely lead to bad results.

We have entered a throw-away society and ﬁlled the environment with rubbish. What are the causes and what are your solutions? 写作思路 Causes: As technology develops and the living conditions of people improves, people tend to produce more waste and rubbish. There are varieties of one-oﬀ products, and people tend to throw things away more often rather than insisting on them. Solutions: A better system of recycling needs to be designed. Recycling should be easier and more practical for citizens, and the treatment plant should be more advanced. Education of citizens on the importance of reducing waste and recycling needs to be improved and emphasized. Government should introduce policies to encourage citizens reduce waste and perform recycling.

Action speaks louder than words. It’s better to start acting on your beliefs than just talking about it. Discuss this view and give your own opinions. 写作思路 Agree: Everyone can speak words, but not everyone can take actions. Words cannot represent results, but results can immediately show after actions. People can lie with words, but actions will never lie.

Positive and negative impacts on the change of means of communicating in society in the past 10 years 写作思路 Positive: Means of communicating are much faster. People can text, send emails or messages at any time and can get replies in no time. There is no time wasted on waiting. Means of communicating are much more convenient. People can talk to whoever they want without limits. This bring convenience in both personal life and work. These means of communication bring people closer. For example, if a child does not live in the same country with his parents, he can still talk to them all the time. They do not feel they are far apart. Negative: Sometimes people rely too much on these means of communicating that they forget to talk to people around them in real life. They do not talk even if they sit together, and they rather talk to someone over the phone. Health problems may be resulted if looking at computers or phones all the time.

Some people believe that the sole aim of higher education is to make people ready for employment. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Discuss. 写作思路 Disagree: Not every student settles his career in the ﬁeld of his study. Therefore, university education is more about making friends, seeking their goals and interests, and developing skills important for their lives rather than getting ready for employment only. Friends, relationships and the life values students gain from their university education are usually much more important than the practical skills for employment. These can be beneﬁcial for the rest of their lives, not only in employment but also in personal lives. Agree: Since the competition in workforce is become more and more ﬁerce, students should be as ready as possible when they ﬁnish universities and start their careers.

Current problems facing society deserve high priority for funding rather than research for likely future issues. agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: Funding should be distributed based on current situations. We cannot just leave the current problems and focus on future only. Likely future issues are not deﬁnitely happening. If funding is put into likely future issues and they do not happen, it is a waste of resource. Disagree: For the development of a society, we need to look further. We need to identify the likely future problems and solve them so that we will not panic when we face them. According to the plan, current problems should have been solved to a great extent in the past. Therefore, they do not need that much funding.

Please discuss the signiﬁcance of formal written assessments in today 's world to evaluate children 's performance. Do you agree that an education system that assesses the student 's learning by written exam is correct? 写作思路 Agree: Written assessment is a more standardized and fairer way to assess students. Verbal or other forms of assessments may have personal bias in them. Written assessments involve lower costs and can be used in any subject. Disagree: Written assessments are not environmentally friendly. Written assessments are not as eﬃcient as other forms of assessments as they usually take a lot of time for students to complete, and also for professors to correct. Written assessments are limited by locations and time, not as ﬂexible as other forms of assessments.

It is important to preserve the beautiful buildings of the past. Do you agree or disagree?写作思路 Agree: Beautiful buildings of past are symbols of cultures and history. The buildings of diﬀerent places have diﬀerent features, which should be preserved. These buildings can attract tourists and enhance tourism industry. Disagree: Preserving these old buildings makes little sense. As population increases, more land is required for the constructions of other buildings, and these old buildings take up too much space. Over crowing problems may be resulted. Preserving these buildings requires a lot of extra costs, increasing economic burden of the governments.
The means of communicating in society today has changed markedly over the past ten years. In your opinion. What are the positive and negative impacts of this change?
question_zh: 当今社会的沟通方式在过去十年中发生了显着变化。在你看来。这一变化有哪些积极和消极的影响？

question: Pursue scientiﬁc knowledge, for knowledge itself or practical use, which is the most important reason. 写作思路 Practical use: Knowledge itself makes little use if it cannot be practiced. Possessing knowledge is important since we can use the knowledge to make our lives better. Doctors use their knowledge to save lives. Scientists use their knowledge to invent advanced devices. Artists use their knowledge to create beautiful arts for people to enjoy. Every occupation possesses knowledge of their professions and it is put into practice. Knowledge itself: Some knowledge is not for use. It only helps us better understand this world, knowing the reasoning behind the phenomenon. Therefore, knowledge itself is the foundation of what we should learn.

Mass media, including TV and newspapers, has a great inﬂuence on humans, particularly on the younger generation. It has a pivotal role in shaping people 's opinions. Discuss the extent you agree or disagree. Use your own experience or examples. 写作思路 Agree: People’s opinions tend be aﬀected by others. Mass media can transfer varieties of views and opinions very quickly, and people nowadays tend to believe in what they learn from mass media. This is how TV, radio and newspaper can shape our opinions. Our society has been changing due to the mass media. In the past, news cannot be transferred so quickly, and people’s opinions have no chances to be exchanged. With mass media, once something happens, the news can be spread all over the world in a second and people start to share their own opinions. Mass media also inﬂuences our society in a negative way. Fake news can also be spread very quickly, and some news is over emphasized. People are easier to panic due to what they learn from mass media, although the news may not be true. Information in mass media needs more control.

The information revolution brought about by modern mass communication has positive and negative consequences for both individuals and society. Do you agree or disagree? Discuss and give examples and your own experience. 写作思路 Positive: Information can be transferred more rapidly and people can receive news from all over the world without barriers. Therefore, the society can react more quickly according to public’s reaction to certain news, which is good for development. People have more opportunities to share and communicate their opinions and views, thus understanding more about other cultures, religions and concepts, bringing the world closer. Negative: Fake news can also be spread very quickly, and some news is over emphasized. People are easier to panic due to what they learn from media, although the news may not be true. Information in mass media needs more control. Criminals may utilize the features of mass communication to spread bad or fake news in order to achieve their goals more easily.

Whether formal written examinations can be a valid method to assess the learning of students. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: The written assessment is a more standardized and fairer way to assess students. Verbal or other forms of assessments may have personal bias in them. Written assessments involve lower costs and can be used in any subject. Disagree: Written assessments are not environmentally friendly. Written assessments are not as eﬃcient as other forms of assessments as they usually take a lot of time for students to complete, and also for professors to correct. Written assessments are limited by locations and time, not as ﬂexible as other forms of assessments.

In the past 100 years, there have been many inventions, such as antibiotics, airplanes, and computers. What do you think is the most important of them? Why? 写作思路 Antibiotics: Antibiotics can cure diseases which were not treatable in the past. This can increase people’s life expectancy, therefore it is very important. Airplane: The invention of airplanes make long-distance journeys possible, bringing the world closer. People can travel to diﬀerent areas of the world freely, looking at diﬀerent cultures and accepting diﬀerent opinions. Computers: Computers eliminate barriers of communications around the world. People can talk to each other without the limits of locations and time. News spreads much more rapidly and people can accept new information at any time. Many things such as typing and researching become much easier and more convenient.

Nowadays, more and more people engage in dangerous activities, such as skydiving and motorcycling. Are you in favor of them? Why? Use examples to support your opinion. 写作思路 not in favor of: There are thousands of deaths and injuries due to extreme sports every year. Extreme sports utilize the natural environment. Since they are becoming more and more popular, many natural environments have been damaged. In favor of: As technology develops, extreme sports do not result in as many deaths as in the past, therefore, as long as the protection is suﬃcient There are varieties of physical and psychological beneﬁts such as developing courage, keeping healthy, building conﬁdence and releasing pressure. Extreme sports are very popular around the world. They are good tools for people around the world to communicate with each other.

Some people think the educational purpose is to have a better life in the future; others argue that its aim is only for self-improvement. What is your opinion? Your essay should be based on your own experiences and examples. 写作思路 Better life: Education is usually for the preparation of future employment. Getting good education means a higher possibility to get a good employment and have a better life in the future. Education provides students with necessary skills to ﬁnd a job in the future, and the aim of ﬁnding a job is to live a better life. Self-improvement: Educational level is not an indication of the quality of future life. There are enormous examples of successful celebrities who do not obtain good degrees. Therefore, the process of education is mainly about self-improvement. Most people do not settle their careers in the ﬁeld of their education; therefore, it is not what they knowledge they get from the education matters, but the relationships and life values that are gained during the education matters.

There is no value in traveling overseas to study, as you can be a good scholar even without leaving your home base. Is it necessary to travel overseas for a better education? 写作思路 Agree: Reading something in a book can never compare with looking at it by oneself. For example, reading about a mountain is not the same as climbing it and looking down from the top. Travelling can help people make more friends from diﬀerent cultural backgrounds, giving people opportunities to share their opinions. These chances can not be gained through books only. Disagree: Travelling takes too much time, costs and energy which may not be aﬀordable for many people. Therefore, it is not realistic to make travel a component to improve education quality. As technology develops, travelling is not the only method to communicate with people from diﬀerent areas and cultural backgrounds. The internet has helped people make friends all over the world without leaving their homes.

Cultural shock is a new worry concern for less immigration. What are the possible opinions to eradicate this issue? 写作思路 Travelling should be encouraged. If people travel more often and meet other people from diﬀerent cultural backgrounds, they will not be aﬀected by cultural shock. Governments can organize societies, workshops and activities to invite immigrants, educating them on the local culture. Local residents can also be invited to share their opinions with migrants so that migrants can get used to the new culture more quickly. Governments can organize workshops which invite both new and old migrants so that old migrants can share their experience with the new ones and help new ones get over cultural shock.

Do you think English will remain to be a global language despite globalization?写作思路 Agree: English is the most widely spoken language at the moment. It is spoken in most continents as either ﬁrst or second language. Therefore, globalization can only make English more widely spoken since it is the most likely language that can be spoken by everyone. For example, in China, Europe and South America, most countries speak English as a second language, and it will be always the main language when people from these countries communicate with people from other countries. Disagree: Due to the increase of immigration, almost in every country, there are varieties of language speakers. Most people can ﬁnd someone speaking the same language with them wherever in the world, therefore, they do not have to learn English to be able to live in a certain country. For example in Australia, in many areas, people speaking only mandarin can live without diﬃculties. They do not have to learn English.

There is no need for newspapers in the modern world. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: As technology develops, there are much quicker ways to spread news, such as the internet. Therefore, not many people insist on reading newspapers nowadays. News on the internet is quicker and more. Newspapers are not environmentally friendly. Disagree: Newspapers are reliable resources of news. Everyone can write on the internet, making the news on the internet not reliable. However, news on the newspapers has been veriﬁed before being reported. Some people have no access to the internet or other resources of news at the moment. Therefore, newspapers are still necessary. Old people tend to be used to reading newspapers and most of them are not willing to accept or learn new technology. Therefore, newspapers are still the best choices for them to obtain news.

A competitive environment in school and university would bring excellence and need to be encouraged. Agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: No pressure, no motivations. Competitive environment in school and university provides students with pressure; thus giving them motivations. Only a competitive environment can help students make progress. If on one competes with them, they may be easily satisﬁed with the current situations, but once there is competition, they will try harder to do better. There are more competitive environments when they start their career, therefore, proper competition in school and university prepare students with future career. Disagree: Competitive environment gives students too much pressure, which may be bad for their physical and psychological health. Students are not as strong as adults. Competition may bring some negative eﬀects, such as cheating.

Does the advent of the Internet change the role of the teacher? To what extent do you agree? 写作思路 Agree: With the Internet, students can access to varieties of information by themselves, and teacher is more about helping and assisting. This is diﬀerent from the past when teachers need to tell students everything. Self-learning is more common and important. Teachers can just give out assignments, let students research, and show the answers. Disagree: No matter how advanced the internet is, teachers are not replaceable. The role of a teacher is to impart knowledge to students. It is not possible for students to look up on the Internet and totally master a subject. The information on the Internet is not reliable. Therefore, students do need teachers to clarify.

Some eﬀective people like repetitive routines, such as eating the same food, do you like this way? 写作思路 Like: Repetitive routine can help people avoid wasting time on thinking about options and changes, and spend more time on meaningful things. Repetitive routine is good for developing a good habit. People sticking to repetitive routines tend to be easier to develop a good habit. Dislike: Life needs changes, or you will get tired of it one day. Only if changes happen, you can have the enthusiasm to live on. People who like repetitive routine may not be able to handle sudden changes in life well enough. They are not used to changes and may panic when they happen.

Some people suggest that each family should only have one car and encourage alternative vehicles. Do you agree? 写作思路 Agree: Each family having only one car reduces gas emission, thus solving pollution problems and improving air conditions, which is much more environmentally friendly. Each family having only one car can signiﬁcantly reduce the traﬃc and the pressure of the roads, which saves money for government and saves time for residents. For families themselves, this is a much more cost-eﬃcient option, saving a great amount of money by not buying multiple cars. Disagree: This is not convenient. If there is an emergency, it may be harder to deal with the situation. This will increase the pressure of public transport, which means the government needs more investment in public transport system.

The world 's governments and organizations are facing a lot of issues. Which do you think is the most pressing problem for the inhabitants of our planet and give the solution? 写作思路 Problem: Global warming Causes: Recently, green house gases emission has been increasing due to varieties of human activities. Eﬀects (why important): The climate of the world has been changing, and the average temperature has been increasing. Polar ice melts and sea level rises, resulting in loss of habitats of polar wild lives. The amount of pollutants in the air increases dramatically, which is really bad for humans’ health. Solutions: Governments need to introduce stricter laws to reduce the emission of green house gases into the air. Punishment and rewards need to be introduced. Education of citizens on the importance of this issue needs to be improved.

With enough amounts of motivation and practice, people can learn anything that the experts teach in the classroom. Do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: Anything can be learned through practice and motivation. For example, a lot people start to learn piano after they retire, and some of them can play it very well after practice. Practice makes perfect and it is true for anything. Disagree: There are many things that require talents to learn, such as music and painting. With the same amount of practice and motivation, some people can perform the task much better than others. It means not only motivation and practice matter. Everyone’s brain is genetically diﬀerent from others’. It means that it is normal that some people are good at one thing and the others good at other things. Therefore, even with enough motivation and practice, a person may not be able to learn anything.

It is argued that getting married before ﬁnishing your studies or getting established in a good job is foolish. To what extent do you agree or disagree? 写作思路 Agree: Getting married usually means a larger economic burden on both sides. Before completing studies, the economic condition is usually not suitable to get married. Getting married can be a distraction from study since there are a lot of family-related issues that need to be considered. This may lead to a poor academic results. People cannot focus on their career development after graduation once get married since they need to think about other stuﬀ such as starting a family. It means the economic condition will not get any better. Getting married too early may lead to a higher rate of divorce since they may not have considered carefully beforehand. Students are not mature enough to take the responsibility of a family. They have not even accepted the challenges from the society and career. Disagree: Getting married can help students build a sense of responsibility which can be very useful in their future careers. When two people work together, the economic conditions can be improved more easily. The pressure of the family can provide students with motivations to strive.

"In a war of ideas, it is people who get killed ". Does a common man suﬀer from a group 's ideology? Express your opinion, and support the same with reasons and examples. 写作思路 Agree: People’s views largely dependent on others’ view. If a man is a part of a group, his view can be aﬀected by other members, and this is how group’s ideology forms. It is usually cannot be avoided.

The illiterate of the 21st century will not be those who cannot read and write, but those who cannot learn, unlearn, and relearn. Agree or Disagree? 写作思路 Agree: In the 21st century, there are enormous opportunities and resources of learning. Even if you cannot read or write, you are still able to gain opportunities if you are willing to learn. Reading and writing are not the most important skills in the modern society. There are other more valuable skills such as innovations and new ideas. Even if you can read and write, if you stop learning new things, you will be soon kicked out of the modern society since the society is developing too fast. You will be left behind quickly and you cannot have any opportunities. This is the real illiterate of the 21st century. Disagree: Reading and writing are still the basic skills to survive in this society. Without reading or writing, even though learning resources are suﬃcient, you still do not have a starting point to learn.

Communication has changed signiﬁcantly in the last 10 years. Discuss the pros and cons of impacts. 写作思路 Pros: Communication is much easier and quicker nowadays. Instead of writing letters and waiting for reply, messages and emails help people communicate whenever they like, wherever they are. It is very convenient in both personal lives and business world. People have more chances to communicate with people from diﬀerent backgrounds and diﬀerent cultures. The new communication era has brought the world closer. People can more easily broaden their horizons and widen their views. Information can be spread much more quickly, and people can be up to date of what is happening in the world easily. Cons: Sometimes people rely too much on social media that they forget to talk to people around them in real life. They do not talk even if they sit together, and they rather talk to someone over the phone. Health problems may be resulted if looking at computers or phones all the time. Fake news can be spread very quickly, and some news is over emphasized. People are easier to panic due to what they learn from media, although the messages may be misleading.

Some people believe the law changes human behavior while others think laws have little eﬀect. What is your opinion? 写作思路 Agree: Laws introduce harsh penalties on unacceptable behaviors, therefore can have some restrictions on human behaviour. Laws give people a discipline on what is right and what is wrong, so that people can follow these rules and avoid behaviors that are not appropriate. This is how laws change human behavior. Disagree: Human behavior is deﬁned by one’s way of thinking. People without intention of performing crimes will not perform crimes even though there are no laws. In contrary, criminals cannot be stopped by laws.

The environment we live in is in danger due to various problems. What are the underlying causes? Who is responsible for combating this? What measures? 写作思路 Problem: Global warming Causes and eﬀects: Recently, green house gases emission has been increasing due to varieties of human activities. The climate of the world has been changing, and the average temperature has been increasing. Polar ice melts and sea level rises, resulting in loss of habitats of polar wild lives. The amount of pollutants in the air increases dramatically, which is really bad for humans’ health. Who is responsible: Individuals: Every individual does not have enough consciousness about the problem. We produce too much waste and pollutant in our everyday lives. Industries: To gain more proﬁts, companies do not control their emissions and do not care about environmental problems. Governments: governments’ policies are not strict enough to control the behaviors of individuals and companies. They have not taken appropriate actions to deal with the problem. Solutions: Governments need to introduce stricter laws to reduce the emission of green house gases into the air, from both individuals and industries. Punishment and rewards need to be introduced. Education of citizens on the importance of this issue needs to be improved.

Do you believe that the industrial revolution was the main factor for problems in developed nations? 写作思路 Agree: During industrial revolution, the environment was damaged to a great extent, which is not reversible. This is a main problem of developed nations. Industrial revolution has changed people’s life style and the nation’s operation totally, therefore, it is a main factor for the current problems. Disagree: Although industrial revolution resulted in environmental problems, it brings much more beneﬁts to the society. And also, the environmental laws introduced at that time have brought a lot of environmental beneﬁts. The industrial revolution itself should bring massive beneﬁts. It is the human activities later that cause problems.

Should marketing in companies producing consumer goods like food and clothing, place emphasis on the reputation of the company or short-term strategies like discounts and special oﬀers? Why? 写作思路 Reputation: Short-term strategies can only attract short-term customers. Once the promotions are over, customers disappear. In contrary, building good reputation is the key of attracting long-term customers. Sometimes short-term strategies give the customers impression that the company is not doing so well, thus customers stop coming to the stores. Reputation is the key to attract customers. Short-term strategies: No one can resist a promotion or discount. Short-term strategies can have a boom of proﬁts. If short-term strategies are used well, reputation can be built as well, which can attract long- term customers.

Climate change is a concerning global issue. Who should take the responsibility, governments, big companies, or individuals? 写作思路 Causes and eﬀects: Recently, greenhouse gases emission has been increasing due to varieties of human activities. The climate of the world has been changing, and the average temperature has been increasing. Polar ice melts and sea level rises, resulting in the loss of habitats of polar wild lives. The amount of pollutants in the air increases dramatically, which is really bad for humans’ health. Who is responsible: Both industries and governments are responsible. Industries: To gain more proﬁts, companies do not control their emissions and do not care about environmental problems. Governments: governments’ policies are not strict enough to control the behaviors of individuals and companies. They have not taken appropriate actions to deal with the problem.

Parents should be held legally responsible for their children 's acts. What is your opinion? Support it with personal examples. 写作思路 Agree: Children’s behaviour and way of thinking are largely aﬀected by their parents. They imitate what their parents do and copy their parents’ ways of thinking. Therefore, parents should be responsible for their children’s acts. Parents have the responsibility to teach children the right things since they are the primary source of children’s learning. Therefore, if children have inappropriate acts, parents have their responsibility. Children are too young to take their own responsibilities, therefore, parents need to be held responsible so that children’s acts can be legally controlled. Disagree: Everyone is a independent individual. Parents cannot control what their children do so they should be held legally responsible for their acts.

Nowadays, it is increasingly more diﬃcult to maintain the right balance between work and other aspects of one’s life, such as leisure time with family members. How important do you think this balance is? Why do people ﬁnd it hard to achieve? 写作思路 Why it is important

title_en: people need to understand that work is a kind of tool for living, and the aim of working hard is to provide better life for our families.
title_zh: 人们需要明白，工作是一种生活工具，努力工作的目的是为了让家人过上更好的生活。

title_en: Nowadays many kids suﬀer from autism due to the fact that parents spend too much time on work and forget the feelings from their kids.
title_zh: 现在很多孩子患有自闭症，是因为父母花太多时间在工作上，忘记了孩子的感受。

title_en: Some young people suﬀer from chronic disease or even cancer because they continue to work for a long time, lacking the awareness of balancing their work and personal life.

question: Do you think consumers should avoid over-packaged products or it is the responsibility of the producer to avoid extra packaging of products? Give your views or any relevant example with your own experience. 写作思路 Consumer: Packaging is one of the ways for brands to stand out in the ﬁerce competition. Therefore, it is not realistic for producers to avoid extra packaging. Packaging is an indication for consumers when they choose their preferred products, therefore it is important. Some consumers may still choose one product even if it is over- packaged. It is consumer’s own decision.

In many towns and cities, large shopping malls are replacing small shops. What is your opinion about this? Discuss with appropriate examples. 写作思路 Large shopping malls: Large shopping malls can accommodate more goods. Varieties of goods can be displayed in one building so that customer can have a one-stop shopping experience. For the same products, people have more choices in large shopping malls with diﬀerent brands. People can compare prices and features that they require and purchase the most satisfying products. Other facilities can be built in large shopping malls such as food courts and cinemas. People can not only enjoy shopping but also enjoy other services. Small shops: Prices of goods are lower due to lower costs. Small shops are more convenient for local people. They tend to be in communities so that people can just get downstairs and get whatever they need. There are no problems related to large shopping malls such as over-crowding and parking.

The decision made may not what majority people want. A good leader is very important to a nation, therefore, compulsory voting force citizens to review the candidates and select the one who is the most appropriate. Disagree: Voting is the legal right of citizens, therefore, citizens should have the freedom to choose perform it or not. In contrary, if voting is compulsory, many people just randomly choose one, which cannot be considered eﬀective anyway. These votes cannot represent people’s real thoughts.

Today, many employers involve their employees in the decision-making process of products and services. What are the advantages and disadvantages? 写作思路 Agree: The more people involved in decision-making process, the more opinions can be considered. New views and ideas may spark unexpectedly good results. Getting employees in decision-making process is a symbol of respect. Employers and employees should show their respect to each other so that the company can operate smoothly. Disagree: Too many opinions may make the decision-making process slower and less eﬃcient.

Learning a new language at an early age is helpful for children. Is it more positive for their future aspect or have some adverse eﬀects? 写作思路 Positive: It is important to learn a new language since nowadays, the boundaries between countries become more and more blurry. Everyone has chances to travel to other countries or communicate with people from other cultural backgrounds. The competition in workforce is ﬁerce. A new language can deﬁnitely help children become outstanding among their competitors, thus obtaining a better employment in the future. Adverse eﬀects: If the new language is learned at a very young age, they may not be very good at their mother languages, which is not a positive thing. At a young age, using two languages can confuse children.

Television has many functions to play in everyone 's life. For some, it 's relaxation; for some, it is a companion. To what extent do you think the statement is true? Please provide your argument and supporting evidence from your own experience. 写作思路 Relaxation: Television provides varieties of entertaining programs. This is a great way of relaxation after working or studying. Everyone can choose whatever they like to watch. People can completely think nothing when watching television. They just follow the programs on the TV and laugh. This is a good way of relaxation, stopping thinking about the troubles in their lives. Companion: Television not only provides entertaining contents. It is involved in every aspect of our lives. For example, we watch news, dramas, scientiﬁc programs, health programs and so on. It means television is not limited to relaxation. We obtain most of the knowledge and information through televisions today, and we learn. Therefore, television is more about companion. For some people who live alone, they keep televisions on just for companion. It is not important what is shown on the television. What it important is that televisions keep making interesting sounds and giving out information, which keep them companion.
